meta.method: exploratory analysis of 40k customer messages: TF-IDF+NMF topic model (14 topics), keyword/bigram frequency analysis, manual review of topic examples and keyword probes
notes: Intents are derived from observed, recurring support interactions for SpotifyCares.
Intent names are operational buckets; mutual exclusivity is enforced through the boundary fields. When a message fits more than one intent, rules in 'priority' below decide.
This taxonomy does NOT include channel issues (e.g. 'I cannot DM you') as standalone intents; such messages are treated as technical_issue boundary cases.
Student discount is folded into subscription_plan because in the data it is overwhelmingly a plan-eligibility/status question, not a refund/charge event.
priority_rules: payment_billing outranks subscription_plan when money movement (charge, refund, payment failure, double charge) is explicitly mentioned.
account_access outranks technical_issue when the message is about logging in, password, hacked, locked, or account recovery.
playback_issue outranks technical_issue when the message is about playback behavior (shuffle, repeat, songs stopping/skipping during listening).
content_missing covers catalog availability (album/song not there, region availability, release timing). If playback fails because the content is unavailable, use content_missing.
appreciation outranks everything else when the message contains only thanks/acknowledgment and reports a positive outcome (works now / fixed).

account_access.description: Problems logging in, password resets, hacked/locked accounts, account recovery, email/facebook login issues, 'logged out and can't get back in', or signing into the wrong/another account.
account_access.escalation_note: Always escalate when there is any sign of account takeover, fraud, or security concern (hacked, someone changed my password, unrecognized activity). Pure 'forgot password' guidance can be auto-handled.
examples: I need help getting into my mother's account. I try logging in with FB and it says that there was an error.
Hi, I need to change my password but never receive the reset email when requested, about 10 times now. Not in spam.
I cannot log in at all after adding my wife to premium family, my account isn't recognized.
my account got hacked and someone changed my email and password
why does it keep logging me out of the app on my iphone
negative_examples: I can't play any songs on the app
boundaries: 'can't stream' without login context is technical_issue, not account_access.
'does not remember me on tv' is device/playback, not account_access.
Payment-status mismatch ('I pay for premium but it shows free') is subscription_plan unless a hack/fraud is implied.
'I don't want to create a spotify account' in a fraud context belongs to payment_billing (fraud/charge), surfaced to humans.

payment_billing.description: Money movement: unexpected charges, double charges, charge after cancellation, card declined/payment failed, chargeback/fraud on card, refund requests for charges, changing payment method, updating billing card, subscription payment date changes.
payment_billing.escalation_note: Any request that involves changing or querying account-specific payment state (refund, double charge investigation, card on file) requires account verification -> escalate. Purely informational billing FAQs may be auto-answered but cannot be resolved here.
examples: I was charged twice for premium this month, what do I do?
Why did I get charged $9.99 when I cancelled last week? I want a refund.
My payment is failing with the new credit card
Who do I contact to change my subscription date? I would like the payment to come out on the 16th
there are monthly charges on my statement and I don't even have a spotify account
negative_examples: my premium is showing as free even though I pay every month
can you remove me from the family plan
boundaries: 'Paying for premium but it is not active' (no money movement incident, just status mismatch) is subscription_plan.
'I want to cancel my premium' is subscription_plan (plan change); a resulting charge still pending is payment_billing.
Chargeback/fraud language always escalates to humans regardless of intent.

subscription_plan.description: Plan structure, eligibility and status: upgrading/downgrading free<->premium, trials and promos, student discount signup/extension, 'I pay for premium but it shows free', how much is premium, cancel/complaints about a plan, premium perks, next billing date questions.
subscription_plan.escalation_note: Auto-handle informational questions and common standard flows. Escalate when account-specific state change is needed (verify premium status for a specific account) if retrieval evidence is weak.
examples: how do I get premium on spotify
I paid for premium a month ago and it still isn't activated
I've had a look at my settings and it says I am assigned to Spotify free when actually I pay every month for premium
How can I extend my student discount?
can I cancel my premium subscription
negative_examples: I was charged twice this month
why can't I add my family to the family plan
boundaries: Student discount pricing/management = subscription_plan; a refund/charge event around it = payment_billing.
Family plan setup/member problems = family_plan (see that intent), NOT subscription_plan.
'Premium not active but I pay' is a status mismatch -> subscription_plan (escalate if resolution not found retrievably).

family_plan.description: Premium Family plan: creating/joining a family plan, adding/removing members, family plan address verification, invite/registration errors, ownership questions ('who owns the family plan'), billing interplay with personal premium.
family_plan.escalation_note: Most family-plan actions require account-specific verification (address match, member invites) -> escalate unless there is a strong historical FAQ match.
examples: how do I add a family member to our premium family plan?
I cannot add my family to my premium for family plan, I always get an error.
why cant I register to our family plan?
hi can u remove me from the family plan as a member?
does my personal premium need to be cancelled when I join a family plan?
negative_examples: how do I cancel my premium
boundaries: A credit-card charge related to family plan is payment_billing; the family membership question itself is family_plan.
Login problems on a family account are account_access.

playback_issue.description: Playback behavior problems: shuffle/repeat not working, songs stopping or skipping mid-play, songs not playing cover-to-cover, random pauses, playback on another device stops, buffering during listening, 'song ends before next starts'.
playback_issue.escalation_note: Auto-handle with standard device troubleshooting. Escalate only if identical fix was already attempted and reported in thread.
examples: my Spotify app will not play an album through cover to cover, instead it goes to shuffle just a few songs in.
it stops playing randomly, on car bluetooth, wifi, anywhere
shuffle and repeat button just don't work and i'm getting frustrated
This is great it has shuffle, but when I switch songs it pauses for 5 seconds
no repeat button on my app?
negative_examples: the app won't open at all
boundaries: 'App crashes when I open it' -> technical_issue.
'Song X is unavailable to play' -> content_missing.
'Playback fails only on a specific device (tv/watch)' -> device_compatibility if it appears to be about device support, otherwise playback_issue.

technical_issue.description: Software malfunction of the app itself: crashes, won't open/load, freezes, installation/reinstall problems, login via oauth/web-api errors, offline downloads not working, web player broken, unknown errors, app functionality missing after update, 'nothing is working'.
technical_issue.escalation_note: Auto only if retrieval returns a matching known fix; otherwise escalate (multi-turn technical issues rarely resolve on public Twitter).
examples: why does my Spotify stop playing while offline? It is songs I've downloaded.
my songs are not downloading on my xperia xa1
the app just crashes when I open it on my android
Having some issues logging in via oauth and unknown errors being returned from the web api
Hey, what's up with me having to update my payment info every month? gets annoying.
negative_examples: I can't log in because I forgot my password
boundaries: Login/password issues -> account_access.
Audio playback behavior (shuffle/repeat/skips) -> playback_issue.
'Song unavailable' -> content_missing.
Device support question ('is Spotify on Samsung TV?') -> device_compatibility.
'I can't DM you' (Twitter channel problem) is treated as technical_issue boundary; escalate only if resolution is not retrievable.

device_compatibility.description: Whether/how Spotify works on a device or platform and device linking: Apple Watch, smart TVs, Xbox/PS, Alexa/Google Home/Car, Chromecast, Spotify Connect, desktop/web, disconnecting a device, 'Spotify isn't available on my device'.
device_compatibility.escalation_note: Mostly informational (supported device list) -> auto. Escalate when account linking/disconnect is needed (e.g., switch alexa account).
examples: does the apple watch support offline listening yet?
why isn't spotify on my samsung tv
how do I disconnect my old account from alexa and connect my premium one?
can I stream to my chromecast from the app
I have a premium account, but the account connected to alexa is not premium. want to switch them
negative_examples: my shuffle doesn't work on my iphone
I got charged twice for premium
boundaries: Playback on a specific device that IS supported (e.g. bluetooth in car) -> playback_issue.
'Log in on tv' problems -> account_access.
Device-specific crash dump -> technical_issue.

content_missing.description: Catalog/availability: an album, song, artist or podcast is missing, delayed, region-locked, removed, or renamed. 'Where is X album', 'this song is not available in my country', 'when will X be on Spotify', 'please fix the song name'.
content_missing.escalation_note: These are label/rights-driven. Auto with informational reply (Spotify cannot add content on request) unless the user alleges a billing/account connection.
examples: WHEREE IS THE ALBUM??
this song is not available in my country
please fix the name of this song from the iconic album
when will you put 'fill up my senses' on spotify
can't get it on my spotify??? why
negative_examples: my app won't play any of my downloaded songs
boundaries: 'Song won't play' with no availability complaint -> playback_issue.
Region availability questions for a service/plan (Spotify in country X) -> content_missing is acceptable; if it is about payment in that country -> payment_billing.
A track available but search shows different cover/name -> content_missing (metadata).

feature_and_feedback.description: Feature requests, product feedback and recommendations: 'please add X feature', 'why can't I do Y', 'your discover tab is bad', presale code questions, feedback about UI/UX, suggestions, complaints about app behavior framed as requests.
feature_and_feedback.escalation_note: Auto-acknowledge (we pass feedback on). No account actions involved.
examples: Are you releasing the presale code for this morning? Not seeing anything
you really need to work on your discover tab, I play one song and all you recommend is stuff I don't like
can you please put 'riot' by X on the app
fell asleep listening to the spice girls and now all of my recommendations are messed up help
why is part of your app so horrendous
boundaries: 'Add this feature so I can play offline' overlapped with technical -> pick feature_and_feedback if the ask is a capability; technical_issue if it is malfunction.
Presale code requests are feature_and_feedback (marketing/info), not subscription_plan, unless they involve the user's plan.

appreciation.description: Pure thanks/acknowledgment or confirmation that an issue is resolved ('works now', 'fixed', 'thank you'). No open problem stated. Operational action: close conversation / no further action.
examples: Thank you!
Dopeee thank u very much
It's working now :D
Thanks, homies.
We're in! Thank you!
negative_examples: thanks but it's still not working
boundaries: 'Thanks, but...' messages that state a NEW problem after thanks -> classify by the new problem.
A message complaining after resolution attempt -> classify by the underlying intent, not appreciation.

other.description: Anything that does not fit the intents above: off-topic, marketing/influencer requests, spam, non-support chatter, ambiguous one-word messages with no recoverable context, or truly unsupported situations.
other.escalation_note: Default to human review when confidence is low and retrieval evidence is weak.
examples: hello
can I get a discount on my food I'm broke
follow me back
dm me
boundaries: Ambiguous short messages are 'other' unless a signal is strong enough for a specific intent.
'dm me' as a standalone is 'other' (no recoverable problem); with context (can't dm, need help via dm) use technical_issue/account context.
